Bank of Anthos Extras Overview\n\nThe `extras/` directory in the Bank of Anthos repository contains optional scripts, samples, and extensions that augment the core application. These extras are not guaranteed to follow the same standards as the mainline application and are provided on a best-effort basis.\n\n## Directory Structure\n\n| Subdirectory | Purpose |\n|--------------|---------|\n| `apigee/` | Apigee + Anthos Service Mesh OAuth integration |\n| `asm-multicluster/` | Anthos Service Mesh multi-cluster deployment demo |\n| `backup/` | Backup for GKE service demonstration |\n| `cloudshell/` | Cloud Shell tutorial for deploying Bank of Anthos |\n| `cloudsql/` | Replace in-cluster PostgreSQL with Google Cloud SQL |\n| `cloudsql-multicluster/` | Multi-region Cloud SQL with Multi Cluster Ingress |\n| `istio/` | Istio ingress gateway manifests |\n| `jwt/` | Pre-built JWT RSA key pair Secret for demo use |\n| `metrics-dashboard/` | Cloud Monitoring dashboard JSON for Java services |\n| `postgres-hpa/` | PostgreSQL HA with Horizontal Pod Autoscaling |\n| `prometheus/` | Google Managed Prometheus (GMP) and OSS Prometheus configs |\n| `tls-domain-managedcerts/` | TLS with Google Managed Certificates |\n| `tls-ip-selfsigned/` | TLS with self-signed certificates and global static IP |\n\n## Key Observations\n\n- **Cloud SQL Integration**: The `cloudsql/` extra provides full Kubernetes manifests (`balance-reader.yaml`, `contacts.yaml`, `frontend.yaml`, `ledger-writer.yaml`, `transaction-history.yaml`, `userservice.yaml`) that add a Cloud SQL Proxy sidecar to backend deployments, replacing the default in-cluster PostgreSQL StatefulSets.\n- **Multi-cluster**: Two distinct multi-cluster approaches are documented: ASM cross-cluster routing (`asm-multicluster/`) and Cloud SQL + Multi Cluster Ingress (`cloudsql-multicluster/`).\n- **Security**: JWT authentication secret (`jwt/`), TLS termination via managed certs (`tls-domain-managedcerts/`), and self-signed certs (`tls-ip-selfsigned/`) are provided as optional security enhancements.\n- **Observability**: Prometheus rules and alertmanager configs (`prometheus/gmp/`, `prometheus/oss/`), plus a Cloud Monitoring dashboard (`metrics-dashboard/dashboard.json`) for Java service metrics.\n- **Scaling**: `postgres-hpa/` demonstrates Horizontal Pod Autoscaler configurations and a load generator for stress testing.\n- **Backup/DR**: `backup/` contains manifests and transformation rules for migrating Bank of Anthos between GKE Standard and GKE Autopilot using Backup for Bank of Anthos Extras — Deployment Configurations and Integration Edges\n\n## Deployment Configurations\n\n### Cloud SQL Proxy Sidecar Pattern\nThe `extras/cloudsql/kubernetes-manifests/` directory contains modified deployment manifests for all backend services. Each Java backend Deployment adds a `cloudsql-proxy` sidecar container:\n\n- **Image**: `gcr.io/cloudsql-docker/gce-proxy:1.37.10`\n- **Purpose**: Provides secure TLS connection between GKE pods and Cloud SQL instance\n- **Configuration**: Reads `connectionName` from the `cloud-sql-admin` Secret\n\nExample from `balance-reader.yaml`:\n```yaml\n- name: cloudsql-proxy\n  image: gcr.io/cloudsql-docker/gce-proxy:1.37.10\n  env:\n  - name: CONNECTION_NAME\n    valueFrom:\n      secretKeyRef:\n        name: cloud-sql-admin\n        key: connectionName\n  command: [\"/cloud_sql_proxy\", \"-instances=$(CONNECTION_NAME)=tcp:5432\"]\n```\n\n### Istio Ingress Gateway\n`extras/istio/frontend-ingress.yaml` defines an Istio `Gateway` and `VirtualService` to expose the frontend via the default Istio ingress gateway:\n- Gateway listens on port 80, HTTP protocol, all hosts\n- VirtualService routes all traffic to the `frontend` service on port 80\n\n### Multi-cluster Service Definitions\n`extras/asm-multicluster/services-all.yaml` contains all Bank of Anthos services as plain Kubernetes Service manifests. These are applied to both clusters so that ASM endpoint discovery can resolve services across clusters.\n\n### TLS Configurations\n\n**Managed Certificates** (`tls-domain-managedcerts/managed-certificates.yaml`):\n- Uses `ManagedCertificate` (GKE-specific CRD) for automatic TLS provisioning\n- Configures a `NodePort` service (`frontend-nodeport`) and an `Ingress` with managed cert annotation\n- Disallows HTTP traffic (`kubernetes.io/ingress.allow-http: \"false\"`)\n\n**Self-signed Certificates** (`tls-ip-selfsigned/`):\n- `FrontendConfig` (`frontend-config.yaml`) enables HTTP→HTTPS redirect with response code `MOVED_PERMANENTLY_DEFAULT`\n- `setup.sh` generates self-signed certs, creates a global static IP, and deploys the application\n- `frontend-ingress.yaml` exposes the frontend via Ingress on ports 80 and 443\n\n### Backup for GKE\n`extras/backup/kubernetes-manifests/` contains:\n- `accounts-db.yaml` — StatefulSet manifest for accounts database\n- `ledger-db.yaml` — StatefulSet manifest for ledger database\n- `ingress.yaml` — Ingress resource for the frontend\n- `transformation-rules.yaml` — Rules used during restore to transform resources between clusters\n\n## Integration Edges\n\n| Source | Target | Integration | Evidence |\n|--------|--------|-------------|----------|\n| Bank of Anthos backend pods |
